//
//  kern_sigs.hpp
//  CarrizoRed
//
//  Builds before Sequoia ship AMDRadeonX4000HWLibs stripped (Sonoma 14.8.9: 55 symbols; Sequoia 15.8.1: 9506), so
//  the CAIL/PowerPlay functions CarrizoRed hooks are found by code there. Generated by scripts/siggen.py from the
//  15.8.1 (24H32) KDK and checked against the 14.8.9 (23J631) KDK: every signature finds the same function in both (the
//  occurrence-th match where the code repeats; all 46 sit at the same offset from their 15.8.1 addresses). Pattern
//  bytes under a 0 mask are rel32 / RIP-relative displacements, which move between builds.
//
